# TPC-DS-OBT Q33

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ss AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_manufact_id,
    SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_i_manufact_id IN (
        SELECT
          obt.item_i_manufact_id
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Books') AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
      )
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998
      AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 1
      AND obt.ship_addr_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk
      AND obt.bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset = 0
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_manufact_id
), cs AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_manufact_id,
    SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_i_manufact_id IN (
        SELECT
          obt.item_i_manufact_id
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Books') AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
      )
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998
      AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 1
      AND obt.bill_addr_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk
      AND obt.bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset = 0
    )
    AND channel = 'catalog'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_manufact_id
), ws AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_manufact_id,
    SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_i_manufact_id IN (
        SELECT
          obt.item_i_manufact_id
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Books') AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
      )
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998
      AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 1
      AND obt.bill_addr_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk
      AND obt.bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset = 0
    )
    AND channel = 'web'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_manufact_id
)
SELECT
  item_i_manufact_id,
  SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
FROM (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ss
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM cs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM ws
) AS tmp1
GROUP BY
  item_i_manufact_id
ORDER BY
  total_sales
LIMIT 100
```
